collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 5-10 and an adult)

collection.description: A child sets out to catch a fish bigger than themselves: sit and fish together, or tell them about the biggest fish you ever saw.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has announced (subject.his/her) life's ambition: to catch a fish bigger than (subject.him/her)self. (subject.He/she) has a line, a hook made from a bent bone, and a worm (subject.he/she) has named Hope. (subject.He/she) has been sitting on the rocks since breakfast. (friend) comes by with lunch and asks how it's going.

choices.label: Tell (subject.him/her) About the Biggest Fish You Ever Saw

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) sits down. They fish all afternoon. (subject) catches a fish about the size of (subject.his/her) thumb, and holds it up next to (subject.his/her) arm, and then next to (subject.his/her) foot, trying to find some part of (subject.him/her)self it's bigger than. Eventually they settle on "bigger than my ear." It's a start.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) describes a fish (friend.he/she) once saw from a canoe, longer than the canoe itself, gliding underneath without a sound. (subject) listens with enormous eyes. (subject.He/she) doesn't catch anything all day. That night (subject.he/she) dreams about the big fish, and in the morning (subject.he/she) is back on the rocks with a new worm, called Hope Two.
